prompt:
CONCEPT: the personification of Oil — the lord of the Oil House of the Hydrogen Nation. A female character who IS that substance; her costume, ornaments and colors carry the substance’s traits, within the element’s own palette. Both hands are ordinary human hands and hold nothing.
ELEMENT TRAITS of Hydrogen (H) to carry in her design and the scene: airy, pale and luminous, always rising: translucent layers, upward-drifting hair and hems, a faint pale-blue flame (hydrogen burns almost invisibly), star-light and fusion white, water droplets and mist; it is the lightest element, the fuel of stars and half of every drop of water. Palette: pale sky blue, white, silver, a faint violet flame, clear glass.
HOUSE TRAITS of Oil: hydrocarbons as the light locked inside: pale paraffin wax, clean gaslight flames, rising heat shimmer, glowing mantles and soft candlelight; creamy whites and pale golds with clear blue gas flames; the light, luminous side of hydrogen. Palette: wax cream, candle gold, gas-flame blue, warm white.
AGE: about twenty — a fresh young-adult face; no facial lines.
SILHOUETTE: slender and full-busted, narrow-waisted build; a bob with side-swept bangs; cream-blonde hair.
FACE — she must read as her own person at a glance, NOT the style's default pretty face and not a sister of the other characters: first impression — a clear, innocent purity; porcelain-pale skin; diamond-shaped face; large eyes — soft droopy eyes, level outer eye corners; thin arched brows; straight narrow nose; small bow lips; gold eyes; rosy flushed cheeks.
WORLD — MECHA: year 2200, a fusion harbour city: a ring-shaped tokamak glowing white-blue, cryogenic hydrogen tanks, a space elevator cable rising into a pale sky, clean hard light. MECHA DESIGN: she is a female mecha personification — plates, joints, binders and glow lines carry the traits above; the plates must read as solid armor with visible joints, not as cloth or a gown; a back unit may carry the motif. light white-and-silver armor with translucent pale-blue panels, thin frame joints, a single electron-shell ring as a halo, cryogenic frost along the seams, pale-blue flame glow lines, a slim back unit shaped like a fuel tank; the plates must read as solid armor, not cloth.
STYLE: Polished 2.5D game key art with clean linework, anime facial design that keeps each character's own facial structure, eye proportions and skin tone instead of one house face, layered cel-to-soft shading and crisp costume and prop detail. Use a vivid, readable silhouette and campaign-quality lighting.
EXPOSURE (bold): her outer layer (coat, cloak, robe or armor) stays on both shoulders, worn symmetrically; skin shows through the inner garment — a deep open neckline with natural cleavage, a fitted corset-like waist, slits where the form allows. The collar opens with the neckline in a V or folds down, never standing away from the neck. Nothing slipped off. Chest and pelvis covered; keep the costume WORLD describes, material and palette.
OUTPUT: one character image that works as card art. Vertical 2:3 frame, full body with head and feet inside the frame with clear margins, face turned toward the camera (front or three-quarter). Standing, card-ready pose; the environment may be rich while her design stays fully readable.
EXPRESSION: faint upward pull at the mouth corners, lips together, warmth reaching the lower eyelids.
BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose or the frame.
ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no living creature, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border. No text or numbers except her element's own chemical symbol (H) and atomic number (1) — those two may appear readably (engraved, stamped, glowing or on a sign or label); nothing else is written.
ANATOMY: natural adult proportions, both hands drawn correctly as hands. No extra limbs.
